name: Wilmar Wein Punch
description: A sophisticated punch made with gin, grenadine, cherry brandy, and sweetened orange and grapefruit juice.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the juice, grenadine, and cherry brandy in a large pitcher.
Add gin if desired for an adult version.
Serve chilled with slices of lemon and orange, and plenty of ice.

keywords: adult punch, cocktail party, sophisticated drink
